title: Number guessing game logic
prompt: Implement `int guesses(int secret, int maxAttempts)` that simulates a player who guesses 1, 2, 3, ... in order. Return the attempt number on which the secret is guessed, or `-1` if `maxAttempts` runs out first. `guesses(4, 10)` returns 4.

tests.name: found in time
tests.hint: Sequential guessing: attempt n guesses the value n.

tests.name: out of attempts
tests.hint: The loop ends when maxAttempts is exhausted — report failure.

tests.name: boundary
tests.hint: The last allowed attempt still counts.
